name: LedgerPro
description:
Ledger is an accounting platform built for accounting firms. This connector lets Claude read a firm's books directly: trial balance, profit & loss, balance sheet and cash flow for any client company, along with sales invoices, supplier bills, customers and suppliers.

Two capabilities have no real equivalent elsewhere. Firm-wide views answer questions that normally mean a spreadsheet — “which of my clients has the largest overdue receivables?” spans an entire client portfolio in a single question, each business reported in its own currency. And every document carries a tamper-evident, hash-chained audit trail, so “prove this invoice was not altered after it was approved” is answerable live.

The connector is read-only. No tool can create, modify, approve, post or delete anything.

Access is granted per business. After signing in, a consent screen lists every business the account can reach, each with a checkbox — whatever is left unticked is not merely hidden from the interface, it is unreachable at the API layer. Three independent gates apply to every call: the OAuth grant, the token's entity scope, and the user's own per-entity permission in Ledger. Reporting is governed by a separate permission, so an account can legitimately read invoices while being refused the trial balance. A refusal returns plain language, never a raw error code.

Authentication is OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration, PKCE and resource indicators — there is no client ID or secret to obtain and nothing to configure in Ledger beforehand. All customer data is stored in the EU.

_published_faq.name: How do I add LedgerPro to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add LedgerPro to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.ledgerpro.ai/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the LedgerPro MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: LedgerPro lists 18 MCP tools, including firm_overdue_receivables, firm_unreconciled_summary, get_audit_trail, get_balance_sheet, get_bill, get_cash_flow, get_cash_flow_indirect, get_contact, get_invoice, get_profit_and_loss, get_trial_balance, and list_bills.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to LedgerPro?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to LedgerPro in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
LedgerPro requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
LedgerPro is developed by Jumpstone Technology Inc. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
